fact: On 10 February 2025 ANSI's director-general said the agency was working with 43 public structures that had requested its electronic document management (GED) software, already installed at 11, after providing it to the justice ministry.
title: Installation d'un logiciel de Gestion Electronique des Documents au Ministère en charge de la Justice : Vers une gestion de plus en plus électronique des courriers et autres documents administratifs
